title: Minot AFB all ten missiles down after UFO
place_text: Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota

tellings.quote: Uh again, another witness has come forward, man by the name of David Shindell,

plain: In 1966, at Minot Air Force Base in North Dakota, all ten nuclear missiles in one group are said to have shut down after a UFO appeared nearby. A former Air Force officer named Robert Salas tells this on the show and says it comes from another witness who came forward, a man named David Schindele. If true, it would mean something unknown could switch off American nuclear weapons.
